translations.web: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translations.bsb: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
